experiment: Task combinations: soft row sharing, all layers; three pairwise gates

metric_policy.macro_task_accuracy: Equal-weight mean over only the tasks present in the run; different task sets are not directly comparable on macro accuracy.
metric_policy.precision: Metrics retain source precision. Epoch histories have four decimals; best/opt final summaries and test metrics have six. Selected validation epochs are inferred from rounded history; ties may be ambiguous.
metric_policy.test_usage: Descriptive evaluation of best (validation overall), opt (validation task macro), and final epoch checkpoints.
metric_policy.missing_tasks: Absent tasks are omitted in JSON and blank in CSV.
metric_policy.evidence: One seed per combination; no multi-seed stability claim.
